name: angular-expressjs-openapi-monorepo
description: Monorepo containing Angular 19 frontend and Express.js OpenAPI authentication API

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && cd api-authentication && npm run clean && cd ../frontend && rm -rf dist
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api-authentication && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
